illustrator.headersHelper: prefs=$(jq -r --arg version "$(watch-app find com.adobe.illustratorBeta | jq -r 'first(.[][]).version')" 'select(has($version)) | input_filename | sub("\\.runConfig$"; "Adobe Illustrator Prefs")' "$HOME"/Library/Preferences/Adobe\ Illustrator*Settings/*/.runConfig) && rg -o '/AuthToken \[ [0-9]+[[:space:]]+([0-9a-f[:space:]]+)\]' -r '$1' "$prefs" | tr -d ' \t\n' | xxd -r -p | jq -R '{Authorization: "Bearer \(.)"}'
illustrator.http_headers_helper: prefs=$(jq -r --arg version "$(watch-app find com.adobe.illustratorBeta | jq -r 'first(.[][]).version')" 'select(has($version)) | input_filename | sub("\\.runConfig$"; "Adobe Illustrator Prefs")' "$HOME"/Library/Preferences/Adobe\ Illustrator*Settings/*/.runConfig) && rg -o '/AuthToken \[ [0-9]+[[:space:]]+([0-9a-f[:space:]]+)\]' -r '$1' "$prefs" | tr -d ' \t\n' | xxd -r -p | jq -R '{Authorization: "Bearer \(.)"}'
